finding: Ordinary Git status and diff can run repository clean filters even when external diff/textconv/hooks/fsmonitor are disabled. An isolated marker-only fixture reproduced both paths.
fix: Status and diff use a private Git view with fixed configuration, bounded copied index and pinned object storage. Repository config/filter includes cannot execute during raw content comparison.

tests.coverage: Malicious clean-filter and hook markers remain absent; staged, unstaged and unborn-index queries and file recovery regressions pass.

limits: Git query results compare raw bytes; custom clean/filter/autocrlf conversions are intentionally not inherited.
No network, paid inference, service mutations or full suite.
